a: A blocker is an issue that stops progress until it is resolved.
A spike is time-boxed research to reduce uncertainty before implementation.
A regression is when a previously working feature breaks after a change.
A hotfix is an urgent production fix outside the normal release train.
A tech spec describes how a feature will be built and why key choices were made.
Acceptance criteria define conditions that must be true for a story to be done.
Definition of Done is the team checklist for quality before calling work complete.
A handoff transfers ownership of work between people or teams with context.
Repro steps are the exact actions to reproduce a bug.
Root cause is the underlying reason a defect happened, not just the symptom.
A workaround temporarily avoids a problem without a full fix.
A rollout is the controlled release of a change to users.
